lines.text: This season, Americans will buy twenty-one point three billion dollars of stuff they haven't paid for yet.
Buy now, pay later. A new record.
That's one point three billion more than last year.
Last Cyber Monday, it passed one billion dollars in a single day.
And 82% of it happens on a phone.
Small payments add up. Check the total before you tap.
Follow for more quiet money breakdowns.
